question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)
sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT T2.CustomerID, SUM(T2.Price / T2.Amount), T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.CustomerID = ( SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth ORDER BY Consumption DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T2.CustomerID, T1.Currency
pg_gold_sql: WITH top_customer AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC NULLS LAST, CustomerID LIMIT 1) SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Amount), 0), c.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID JOIN top_customer AS b ON b.CustomerID = t.CustomerID GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
corrections: Choose top customer by total spending; use SUM(price)/SUM(amount) as evidence specifies.
original_pg_sql: SELECT T2.CustomerID, SUM(T2.Price / NULLIF(T2.Amount, 0)), T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth ORDER BY Consumption DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T2.CustomerID, T1.Currency
